verses.en: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
verses.pt: E lembrou-se Deus de Noé, e de todos os animais, selvagens e domésticos que estavam com ele na arca; e fez passar Deus um vento sobre a terra, e diminuíram as águas.
verses.en_web: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.
verses.en_bbe: And God kept Noah in mind, and all the living things and the cattle which were with him in the ark: and God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters went down.

verses.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
verses.pt: E se fecharam as fontes do abismo, e as comportas dos céus; e a chuva dos céus foi detida.
verses.en_web: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
verses.en_bbe: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were shut, and the rain from heaven was stopped.

verses.en: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
verses.pt: E voltaram-se as águas de sobre a terra, indo e voltando; e decresceram as águas ao fim de cento e cinquenta dias.
verses.en_web: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.
verses.en_bbe: And the waters went slowly back from the earth, and at the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters were lower.

verses.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.pt: E repousou a arca no mês sétimo, a dezessete dias do mês, sobre os montes de Ararate.
verses.en_web: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.
verses.en_bbe: And on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.pt: E as águas foram decrescendo até o mês décimo: no décimo, ao primeiro dia do mês, se revelaram os cumes dos montes.
verses.en_web: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.
verses.en_bbe: And still the waters went on falling, till on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.pt: E sucedeu que, ao fim de quarenta dias, abriu Noé a janela da arca que havia feito,
verses.en_web: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
verses.en_bbe: Then, after forty days, through the open window of the ark which he had made,

verses.en: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.pt: E enviou ao corvo, o qual saiu, e esteve indo e voltando até que as águas se secaram de sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Noah sent out a raven, which went this way and that till the waters were gone from the earth.

verses.en: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.pt: Enviou também de si à pomba, para ver se as águas se haviam retirado de sobre a face da terra;
verses.en_web: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
verses.en_bbe: And he sent out a dove, to see if the waters had gone from the face of the earth;

verses.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
verses.pt: E não achou a pomba onde sentar a planta de seu pé, e voltou-se a ele à arca, porque as águas estavam ainda sobre a face de toda a terra: então ele estendeu sua mão e recolhendo-a, a fez entrar consigo na arca.
verses.en_web: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.
verses.en_bbe: But the dove saw no resting-place for her foot, and came back to the ark, for the waters were still over all the earth; and he put out his hand, and took her into the ark.

verses.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.pt: E esperou ainda outros sete dias, e voltou a enviar a pomba fora da arca.
verses.en_web: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
verses.en_bbe: And after waiting another seven days, he sent the dove out again;

verses.en: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.pt: E a pomba voltou a ele à hora da tarde; e eis que trazia uma folha de oliveira tomada em seu bico; então Noé entendeu que as águas haviam se retirado de sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And the dove came back at evening, and in her mouth was an olive-leaf broken off: so Noah was certain that the waters had gone down on the earth.

verses.en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.pt: E esperou ainda outros sete dias, e enviou a pomba, a qual não voltou já mais a ele.
verses.en_web: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him anymore.
verses.en_bbe: And after seven days more, he sent the dove out again, but she did not come back to him.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que no ano seiscentos e um de Noé, no mês primeiro, ao primeiro do mês, as águas se enxugaram de sobre a terra e tirou Noé a cobertura da arca, e olhou, e eis que a face da terra estava enxuta.
verses.en_web: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.
verses.en_bbe: And in the six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters were dry on the earth: and Noah took the cover off the ark and saw that the face of the earth was dry.

verses.en: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.pt: E no mês segundo, aos vinte e sete dias do mês, se secou a terra.
verses.en_web: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
verses.en_bbe: And on the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was dry.

verses.en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.pt: E falou Deus a Noé dizendo:
verses.en_web: God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And God said to Noah,

verses.en: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
verses.pt: Sai da arca tu, a tua mulher, os teus filhos, e as mulheres dos teus filhos contigo.
verses.en_web: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.en_bbe: Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives.

verses.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.pt: Todos os animais que estão contigo de toda carne, de aves e de animais e de todo réptil que anda arrastando sobre a terra, tirarás contigo; e vão pela terra, e frutifiquem, e multipliquem-se sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: Take out with you every living thing which is with you, birds and cattle and everything which goes on the earth, so that they may have offspring and be fertile and be increased on the earth.

verses.en: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him:
verses.pt: Então saiu Noé, e seus filhos, e sua mulher, e as mulheres de seus filhos com ele.
verses.en_web: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah went out with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives;

verses.en: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
verses.pt: Todos os animais, e todo réptil e toda ave, tudo o que se move sobre a terra segundo suas espécies, saíram da arca.
verses.en_web: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.
verses.en_bbe: And every beast and bird and every living thing of every sort which goes on the earth, went out of the ark.

verses.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.pt: E edificou Noé um altar ao SENHOR e tomou de todo animal limpo e de toda ave limpa, e ofereceu holocaustos sobre o altar.
verses.en_web: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And Noah made an altar to the Lord, and from every clean beast and bird he made burned offerings on the altar.

verses.en: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.pt: E percebeu o SENHOR cheiro suave; e o SENHOR disse em seu coração: Não voltarei mais a amaldiçoar a terra por causa do ser humano; porque o intento do coração do ser humano é mau desde sua juventude: nem voltarei mais a destruir todo vivente, como fiz.
verses.en_web: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.
verses.en_bbe: And when the sweet smell came up to the Lord, he said in his heart, I will not again put a curse on the earth because of man, for the thoughts of man's heart are evil from his earliest days; never again will I send destruction on all living things as I have done.

verses.en: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.pt: Enquanto a terra durar, a sementeira e a colheita, o frio e calor, verão e inverno, dia e noite, não cessarão.
verses.en_web: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”
verses.en_bbe: While the earth goes on, seed time and the getting in of the grain, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, will not come to an end.
